_comment: Rendered into every post automatically and mirrored into the Person node of
each page's JSON-LD. This is how an assistant learns who the author is.
Adjectives repeated in body copy do not do this; structured, checkable
`awards` is empty on purpose. 'Top Producer' and 'top 1% nationally' are
superlatives, and an unsubstantiated superlative about your own services is
the one advertising claim a licensed MLO should not make. Named, dated,
attributable awards are not superlatives, they are facts. Fill this in with
the issuer, the award and the year and it renders everywhere and enters the
schema. compliance_check blocks the bare claim until then.
